subject: Acceptance cadence drift — containment proposal and escalation
messages:
From: Matt Shepard <matt.shepard@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@zephyrhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Acceptance timetable

Karthik —

Quick note from the Zephyr side: the security team found a vendor-data-retention item during their review. They want an extra week to sign off on the evidentiary artifacts (SOC config and audit retention). That pushes our internal acceptance window by 7 days.

I'm attaching the reviewer notes; procurement looped me in and said they need the new dates to update the MSA schedule.

Apologies for the short notice — we want to avoid having your infra teams blocked mid-cutover.

Matt

Attachments: zephyr_security_review_notes.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Shepard <matt.shepard@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procure@zephyrhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Acceptance timetable

Matt — thanks for the heads up and the notes. Understood on the extra week.

Proposal to contain the impact:
- We can compress the non-critical acceptance checkpoints (integration smoke -> UI acceptance) into parallel validations during week +1.
- Keep the hard data-migration / cutover milestone fixed; if required we will run a guarded rollback window immediately after cutover.
- I've attached a tracked-change MAP and an early risk log with mitigation owners. Marissa is on this thread and will own procurement communication where we need contractual date updates.

Immediate asks for Zephyr:
1) Confirm the specific artifact the security team requires (the review note referenced three items).
2) If procurement needs formal date changes for the MSA, send a one-line confirmation and the date you'd like reflected.

I'll continue to work the internal schedule; if the slip grows beyond one week we should prepare an exec-level note.

— Karthik

Attachments: proposed_map_v2.pdf (application/pdf), risk_log.csv (text/csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: MAP: Acceptance timetable (internal)

Karthik / Logan —

Reading Karthik's proposal. Two points from GTM/Finance that we should lock before we respond to Procurement:
- If Zephyr formally requests an MSA date change we will need approval for a 1-week SLA credit window (standard playbook). Logan, can you confirm the max credit we can offer without exec sign-off?
- If we compress acceptance and run validations in parallel there is a measurable risk to quality; let's add a contingency post-cutover validation window (owner: Customer Reliability). Add that to the risk_log and mark it medium-severity.

I'm also recommending we pre-draft a short exec escalation note (one page) that summarizes the risk, economic impact, and proposed mitigations so that we can get fast sign-off if the slip extends further. I will start a draft and share by EOD.

Marissa

> On Mon, May 5, 2025 at 11:00 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Proposal to contain the impact:
> > - We can compress the non-critical acceptance checkpoints...
> > - Keep the hard data-migration / cutover milestone fixed; ...
> > Attachments: proposed_map_v2.pdf, risk_log.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Shepard <matt.shepard@zephyrhealth.com>, Procurement <procure@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 May 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP and short-term containment plan

Matt / Zephyr procurement —

Thanks for confirming the security reviewer note this morning. Per our last thread, Redwood is prepared to: 
- Accept a one-week acceptance window slip while keeping the data cutover target of 2025-06-15 intact.
- Run parallel validation workstreams during the slip week to avoid blocking the cutover. Those workstreams are documented in the attached MAP (map_v2-tracked_changes.pdf).
- Execute a guarded rollback plan with a 24-hour post-cutover verification window and clear rollback criteria (see section "Rollback and Verification").

Requests from Zephyr to finalize the change:
1) A short procurement confirmation email with the new acceptance date you want in the MSA.
2) Security artifact owner and a target date for delivery (so we can update our internal owner timeline).
3) If a longer slip is required, a single-corroborating exec contact to expedite approval.

Marissa will be tracking the credit authorization and will follow up separately if Finance requires an approver. I've also added the short exec note Marissa mentioned to the HubSpot record (link below) — feel free to use it when you route internally.

If I don't hear a formal procurement confirmation by EOD tomorrow, we'll move forward with the parallel-validation path but I need procurement's signoff to update the MSA.

Thanks — and apologies for the churn. We prefer to avoid shifting the cutover but are prepared to contain the impact.

— Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: map_v2-tracked_changes.pdf (application/pdf)
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-7892, https://www.docusign.com/link/XYZ-approval-7892
